objective: Las minutas viven SOLO en Dexie (doctrina C31): el backup no duplica esa ruta ni espeja en integrationStore.
dod: npx tsc -b && npx vitest run tests/minutesDexieOnlyGuard.test.ts tests/minutosSinglePublisherGuard.test.ts tests/voiceProfilesLocalStorageGuard.test.ts tests/brandingDexieOnlyGuard.test.ts --reporter=dot

invariant.statement: Sitios en src/ que usan la clave localStorage de minutas (MINUTE_HISTORY / flu-minute-history) o escriben el espejo minuteHistory: fuera del store: 5 -> 0.

metric.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const NL=String.fromCharCode(10);const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):(/[.](ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs)$/.test(e.name)?[path.join(d,e.name)]:[]));let n=0;for(const f of walk('src')){const p=f.split(path.sep).join('/');for(const line of fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split(NL)){const t=line.trim();if(t.startsWith('//')||t.startsWith('*')||t.startsWith('/*'))continue;const m=line.match(/MINUTE_HISTORY|flu-minute-history/g);if(m)n+=m.length;if(p!=='src/store/integrationStore.ts'&&/minuteHistory *:/.test(line))n++;}}console.log(n)"
